notes: in by 6:15am. gardens were lively, twelve warbler species before the crowds rolled in. bailed around 9:30 when it got busy - right call
went midday on a saturday, which was a mistake. west pond trail wall to wall people, birds gone quiet. shouldve gone early, lesson learned
timed the falling tide on purpose and it paid off, flats covered in shorebirds. barely another soul out there
high tide the whole window so no flats, nothing to look at. hot and buggy. wasted trip
grassland edges decent, few sparrows and a kestrel. wind was ripping though, which kept the little birds down
easy to get to but half of brooklyn birds here. decent migrants, mostly just followed other people to their finds, which felt a bit lame
good birds, ridiculously crowded even at 7am. hard to enjoy when the path is basically a parade
cool and clear, light was unreal for photos. long walk on the shore trail and had it to myself. bus over was painless
way too hot and humid, zero shade on the exposed stretches, ran out of water. july here was a mistake
long haul on transit but worth it. cold clear and quiet. would absolutely do again outside peak season
weekday evening so it was calm, grounds were lovely. would NOT try this on a weekend
ferry line was forever and the island was packed. art installations were cool but the logistics ate half the day
food was incredible, crowds and noise a lot. fun once, dont need it often
fossil halls on a cold weekday, place was dead quiet. actually got to stand at each case as long as i wanted. excellent
holiday week, mobbed with families. couldnt get near the exhibits i came for. left early annoyed
good exhibit but those huge galleries wear me out. better in shorter visits i think
small enough to actually do properly in two hours. easy subway ride, sunday morning was quiet
underrated spot. good migrants and a fraction of prospects crowds. gates open late though, so no dawn access
6am again. big overnight push on the radar and it delivered. early plus good radar the night before is the formula here, im convinced
fine but unremarkable. close and easy, highway noise the whole time though. good filler walk, not a destination
